fabric_shader_studio.name: From Source to Skirt — Shader and Fabric Studio
fabric_shader_studio.description: An editable four-by-four source feeds a wall and skirt preview. Inspect UVs, repetition, cut-outs, matte/metal finish and bounded vertex displacement; save/load a recipe, deliberately dress the player or runway performers, and undo application.
interactions: Inspect shader stages with mounted controls
Wear the saved recipe on the skirt
fabric_shader_studio.qfep_connection: A recipe acquires different bodies through their coordinates and material responses; visible cut-outs and displaced vertices do not change collision.
